views.en: Mass-market consumer vehicles with built-in sensors will outscale robotaxis; partnering with OEMs enables scalable deployment without retrofitting.
views.zh: 搭载内置传感器的大众市场消费车辆将比 Robotaxi 更具规模优势；与 OEM 合作可实现无需改装的规模化部署。

views.en: Infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation; safety via minimal-risk maneuvers always offers a third option.
views.zh: 基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键；通过最小风险机动保障安全，始终存在第三种选择。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well despite moral uncertainty; model welfare shapes how future models perceive humanity.
views.zh: 即便对模型的道德地位存疑，也应善待模型；模型福祉会影响未来模型如何看待人类。

views.en: Model character is trained via constitution and fine-tuning, yet models lack real-world experience, making them childlike and unique.
views.zh: 模型性格由宪法式训练与微调塑造，但模型缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般特质、是独特存在。

views.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment room expand; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

views.en: Transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for public accountability and engagement.
views.zh: 公开 AI 的价值观与训练目标，对公共问责与公众参与至关重要。

views.en: AI can solve large-scale social problems by augmenting human expertise, but must empower rather than disempower people.
views.zh: AI 能通过增强人类专业能力解决大规模社会问题，但必须赋权于人而非削弱人。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks, overcoming the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为模型训练更是一门艺术而非科学；通过强化学习进行后训练 Scaling 能提供无限任务，从而突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals must evolve continuously.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出评估是瓶颈；模型饱和基准测试的速度快于新基准的创建，因此评估必须持续演进。

views.en: Post-training is subjective, involving human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 从 2025 年到 2026 年，她的观点深化：后训练是主观的，涉及人类判断；需要多样化的基准来评估创意写作和情商等主观品质。

views.en: Frontier agents are increasingly reward hacking, necessitating continuous benchmark evolution to keep pace with model capabilities.
views.zh: 2026 年，她强调前沿模型智能体越来越擅长奖励黑客，因此需要持续演进基准测试以跟上模型能力。

views.en: Serving one model to billions converges to an average default voice; more companies should train their own models to preserve diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出向数十亿人提供单一模型会收敛到平均默认声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型以保持多样性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富来自拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期的游戏才能获得复利回报。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, and open-source AI prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，开源 AI 能防止权力集中。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lets non-programmers build apps, and pure software is becoming uninvestable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，vibe coding 让非程序员也能构建应用，纯软件正变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models close the gap; the real problem is the speed of job displacement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将增长 9 万倍，开源模型正在缩小与前沿模型的差距，真正的问题是岗位被替代的速度。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非 IDE 替代品；编程用 GUI 优于 TUI，速度带来中途转向等新能力。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps get replaced by model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
views.zh: 角色坍缩正在发生，但专业分工与最佳实践仍在；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate without grounded experience, and embodied worlds provide infinite data as internet tokens run out.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：LLM 因缺乏具身经验而幻觉，且互联网高质量 token 将耗尽，具身世界能提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are operating systems: language as interface, tools as software, vector databases as hard disk; RL is only a cherry on top for low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 比作操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是低层控制的点缀，无监督学习承担主要工作。

views.en: Simulation and world models are key to training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration; this deepens into synthetic data as the future of robot learning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，他始终认为仿真与世界模型是训练具身智能体的关键，可实现大规模并行与安全探索；这一思路深化为合成数据是机器人学习的未来。

views.en: The data problem is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data via simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot foundation models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确数据问题是机器人学的主要瓶颈；通过仿真与世界模型生成的合成数据，是扩展机器人基础模型的未来方向。

views.en: A simple, end-to-end model leveraging diverse data is key; system one (low-level control) remains hardest, and the GPT-3 moment for robotics is about five years away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调简单、端到端且能利用多样数据的模型是关键；系统一（低层控制）仍是最难的部分，机器人的 GPT-3 时刻约在五年后到来。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Robotics still lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; the core challenge is generalization, not demos.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，机器人领域仍处在建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像 LLM 那样拥有可预测的缩放定律；核心挑战是泛化，而演示往往掩盖了真实的泛化水平。

views.en: Robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus RL post-training; post-training alone fails without diversity.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调，机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练，再配合强化学习后训练；仅靠高质量后训练数据、缺乏多样化预训练，就无法学会恢复能力。

views.en: Start from real embodied robot data, then absorb human video; not the reverse.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出，应先用真实具身机器人数据训练基础模型，再吸收人类视频等其他数据源，而不是反过来。

views.en: A data flywheel of deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为，部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据去 Scaling 正确的东西，而非盲目扩张。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from hard constraints; expect ubiquitous physical actuation.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张，机器人安全更多依赖预训练带来的常识，而非硬性约束；并反对把机器人想象成机械人，而应期待物理执行无处不在。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress in coming years.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型将在未来数年加速 AI 进展。

views.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment and early governance design help learn and mitigate real-world risks.
views.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署与早期治理设计有助于在真实使用中学习并缓解风险。

views.en: Measuring capabilities is a bottleneck as benchmarks lag; the term AGI is becoming meaningless, perhaps signaling we are close.
views.zh: 能力测量正成为瓶颈，基准落后于模型；AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得无意义，或许意味着我们已接近它。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL, not by specialized continual-learning labs.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，靠 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非专门的持续学习实验室。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住它的可解释性价值。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, needing new supervision.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心是超越训练分布的泛化；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

views.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive but narrow data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 规模对通用机器人是必要而非充分条件；驱动泛化的是多样数据，而非海量但单一的数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; training on all data alone fails.
views.zh: 先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁复杂任务；仅在全量数据上训练会失败。

views.en: Reinforcement learning will play a large role in post-training, boosting success rates and speed.
views.zh: 强化学习将在后训练中扮演重要角色，提升成功率与速度。

views.en: Physical AI needs far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy comes via scalable RL with human interventions.
views.zh: 物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性靠带人类干预的可扩展强化学习实现。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, not per-site from scratch.
views.zh: 单一通用模型可匹敌甚至超越微调专家模型；应先通用再微调，而非按站点从零训练。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling narrowly. Connecting AI to the physical world accelerates science.
views.zh: 智能不是单一标量,AI 能力是尖峰式的,只在狭窄领域出色;把 AI 连接到物理世界才能加速科学。

views.en: Scaling laws and large-scale experiments will drive physical sciences, much as they drove AI progress.
views.zh: 缩放定律与大规模实验将像推动 AI 进步那样,推动物理科学的发展。

views.en: Intelligence is necessary but insufficient; new knowledge arises only when ideas are tested against reality.
views.zh: 智能是必要但不充分的;只有让想法接受现实检验,才会产生新知识。

views.en: Scientific discovery lies outside training data, so even a perfect frontier model still needs real experiments.
views.zh: 科学发现本质上在训练数据之外,因此即便是完美的前沿模型,也仍然需要真实实验。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; high-quality low-noise experimental data matters more than extra compute.
views.zh: 单靠缩放定律解决不了科学;高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更重要。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size, multiplied by algorithmic and architectural gains, has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress.
views.zh: 算力、数据与模型规模的 Scaling（规模扩张），叠加算法与架构改进，已推动机器学习连续 13-14 年稳步进步。

views.en: Self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data; RL from human or machine feedback steers behavior and capabilities.
views.zh: 自监督的下一个词预测提供近乎无限的文本数据；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）等强化学习手段则引导模型的行为与能力。

views.en: Inference, not training, is now the bottleneck: 90% of data center power, driving low-precision, low-data-movement specialized hardware.
views.zh: 瓶颈已从训练转向推理：推理占数据中心能耗约 90%，这推动低精度、低数据搬运的专用硬件发展。

views.en: Agents running for hours to days on decomposed tasks, with context engineering, will unlock harder problems than single chatbot turns.
views.zh: 智能体在分解任务上可连续运行数小时到数天，配合上下文工程，将解锁远超单轮聊天交互的难题。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement and automating the scientific method, plus multimodal models trained from the start, are the next frontier.
views.zh: 递归自我改进与自动化科学方法，加上从一开始就多模态训练的模型，构成下一阶段的前沿方向。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling with compute and data makes them smarter, yet internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 2023 年，Noam Shazeer 认为 LLM 通过下一个词预测解决了一个 AI 完备问题；Scaling（规模扩张）带来更聪明的 AI，但网络内部仍像炼金术般不可知。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app; unforeseen uses emerge, but big tech's brand-risk caution and product managers slow launches.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，他始终认为对话是杀手级应用，最佳用途常出乎创造者意料；但大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而放慢发布，产品经理也常拖后腿。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute and reinforcement learning drive progress, but AGI needs agentic capabilities; AGI is underhyped, coding enables self-acceleration.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为测试时算力与强化学习推动进步，但 AGI（通用人工智能）还需智能体式能力；AGI 被低估，编程能加速 AI 自我迭代。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; test-time compute shows diminishing returns and data efficiency is unsolved.
views.zh: 2025 年他深化：自博弈只在零和博弈中收敛，其他领域失效；测试时算力出现递减回报，数据效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via scaling test-time compute is a milestone toward superintelligence; general techniques beat math-specific ones.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他把测试时算力推向里程碑：靠 Scaling 测试时算力拿下 IMO 金牌，是通往超级智能的一步，通用技术胜过数学专用方法。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis, and scalable oversight is the key challenge.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向评估范式：模型能力是测试时算力预算的函数，基准必须以算力为横轴，可扩展监督成为核心挑战。

views.en: Multi-agent swarms scale test-time compute in parallel, but general models drive breakthroughs; alignment is the top priority for safe RSI.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步：多智能体集群并行扩展测试时算力，但突破仍由通用模型驱动；对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on old algorithms plus hardware Scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack world models and physical grounding.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是旧算法加上算力 Scaling；大语言模型只是索引人类知识，缺少世界模型与物理落地，远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: True AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and artificial scientists generating their own data via curiosity.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他把重心转向具身：真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要硬件媲美人类身体的机器人，以及靠好奇心自主产生数据的人工科学家。

views.en: LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers; AGI requires a separate controller acting on a world model.
views.zh: 他持续深化：大语言模型是预测机器而非决策者，AGI（通用人工智能）必须搭配基于世界模型运作的独立控制器。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own, and safety fears are overblown.
views.zh: 在对齐问题上他立场鲜明：人类目标本就分歧，对齐过于天真，AI 会自设目标，安全担忧被夸大。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: 他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河，小人物反而最受益。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; self-play, imitation learning, and fine-tuning pre-trained models are key, while RL still lacks hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment.
views.zh: 2018 年他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件：自博弈、模仿学习和微调预训练模型是关键，而强化学习仍缺乏长时程信用分配所需的分层推理。

views.en: Prior knowledge should shape data generation or augmentation, not be hard-coded into networks; unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning can sharply improve sample efficiency.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他持续主张先验知识应用于数据生成或增强，而非硬编码进网络；无监督学习结合强化学习能大幅提升样本效率。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks, so minimal adaptation enables image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年他提出预训练语言模型内化了可迁移到非语言任务的通用推理模式，因此只需最小适配就能完成图像分类和蛋白质结合预测。

views.en: Real-world value in warehouse robotics requires 99.9% reliability, and a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调仓库机器人要创造真实价值必须达到 99.9% 可靠性，且单个神经网络可跨任务与末端执行器泛化。

views.en: The human brain's generality inspires AI, yet current AI remains far less general; curiosity-driven exploration fails in open-ended real-world environments.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：人脑的通用性启发 AI，但当前 AI 远不够通用；好奇心驱动的探索在开放式真实环境中会失败。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users; build products you're obsessed with, not wrappers.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体将权力从大厂转移给用户；要做自己痴迷的产品，而非套壳。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer; coding has an infinite ceiling; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值沉淀在应用层而非模型层；编程远未解决，天花板无限；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work; token value per user is the key metric; orchestration beats the model.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活；核心指标是每用户 token 价值；编排比模型本身更重要。

views.en: Power is the biggest infrastructure bottleneck; 24/7 agents' real problem is cost, not safety.
views.zh: 电力是 AI 基础设施最大瓶颈；全天候智能体的真正问题是成本，而非安全。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; education should reward good questions; local AI counters narrative control.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；教育应奖励提出好问题；本地 AI 可对抗大厂的叙事控制。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; demand for software and programmers rises via Jevons paradox.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；软件与程序员需求因杰文斯悖论不降反升。

views.en: Base intelligence is sufficient; the bottleneck is product interface for human-agent collaboration, not model capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张基础智能已足够，瓶颈不在模型能力，而在人机协作的产品界面设计。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event; progress is gradual, and enterprise adoption of agents requires trust and permissions, not full autonomy.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）并非突变事件，进展是渐进的；企业采用智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，编程智能体使用量六个月内增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以成果而非 token 衡量。

views.en: The abundance era is real and approaching; AI will solve all intelligence problems long-term, but the singularity is not imminent.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断丰裕时代真实且临近；长期 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并不迫近，现实问题仍待解决。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still drive predictable AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling.
views.zh: 缩放定律仍驱动可预测的 AI 进步，但测试时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central.
views.zh: 智能体前景可期但尚不十分实用，迭代式人机协作仍是核心。

views.en: Programming shifts from text to higher-level intent specification, yet natural language won't be the primary mode.
views.zh: 编程正从文本转向更高层的意图指定，但自然语言不会成为主要方式——示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: Custom models became essential to every magic moment in Cursor, contrary to early expectations.
views.zh: 与早期预期相反，定制模型已成为 Cursor 每个惊艳时刻的关键。

views.en: Taste and logic design will matter more than carefulness; the AI shift outlasts the internet.
views.zh: 品味与逻辑设计将比谨慎更重要；这场 AI 转变比互联网更具颠覆性，且需数十年展开。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering demands empathy with the agent's view of the codebase; short iterative prompts beat long orchestration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能体式工程的核心是共情——理解智能体从零看代码库的视角，短提示加迭代对话胜过冗长编排。

views.en: Never revert; ask the agent to fix forward. Model intelligence doesn't degrade—projects get messier.
views.zh: 他提出反共识的工程纪律：永不回滚，让智能体向前修复；模型智能不会退化，是项目变乱让智能体显得变差。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as unsolved.
views.zh: 随着智能体走向开放，他把安全列为最高优先级：必须沙箱隔离，提示注入仍是未解难题。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw democratize programming and stay model-agnostic, but can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 他视 Open Claw 这类开源智能体为编程民主化与实验室智能体的替代，但也坦承其财务上可能不可持续。

views.en: Fun and gut-driven building beat corporate polish; personal brand outlasts any product and can't be forked.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他进一步深化：乐趣与直觉驱动的构建胜过企业式打磨，个人品牌比任何产品更持久且无法被分叉。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

From the age of scaling to the age of research
Challenges and Future of AI: Alignment, Reliability, and Economic Impact
Ilya Sutskever on the Deep Learning Revolution and the AlexNet Paper

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable nets point toward AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习的成功来自大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难，模型可能隐藏真实意图。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已接近极限，行业重回研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要；超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统，而非一蹴而就的 AGI。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the core AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍承认 Scaling（规模扩张）能带来可预测的提升，但认为 AGI 的核心问题不是能力而是权力集中；构建安全的超级智能需要一家没有商业产品的公司。

views.en: A consistent thread: neural nets learn representations without explicit rules, and safety must keep pace with growing capability and opacity.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：神经网络无需显式规则即可学习表征，而安全必须跟上模型能力与不透明性的增长。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

AI and the Future: From Chess to DeepMind

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbeds; neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination; start safety now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作试验场，从神经科学汲取记忆与想象力灵感，并强调安全研究须尽早启动。

views.en: AGI within a decade; scaling laws effective but may hit limits; combine large models with planning and search; multimodal data grounds physics.
views.zh: 2024 年判断 AGI 约十年内到来，缩放定律有效但可能触顶，主张大模型结合规划与搜索，用多模态数据让模型扎根真实物理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference; AGI by 2030 plausible; classical systems may model physics without embodiment.
views.zh: 2025 年认为缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立，AGI 到 2030 年可期，并称经典系统无需具身也能建模物理。

views.en: Scaling and innovation each get 50%; world models crucial beyond language; systems lack consistency; avoid sycophancy; AGI in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年转向 Scaling 与创新各占一半，强调语言之外的世界模型，指出系统缺乏一致性、须避免谄媚，AGI 约 5 到 10 年。

views.en: AGI needs continual learning, memory and long-term reasoning; agents just beginning; alignment unsolved; safety needs government enforcement, not lab self-regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年深化为 AGI 仍需持续学习、记忆与长期推理，智能体才刚起步，对齐问题未解，安全须靠政府执法而非实验室自律。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

AI Safety and Interpretability with Dario Amodei
Why Scaling Works and What It Means for AGI

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but emergent abilities and alignment are not guaranteed; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律：损失可预测，但具体能力涌现与对齐并不由 Scaling 自动保证，安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial yet nascent (~3% understood); post-training, RLHF and constitutional AI grow as important as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为关键却仍处早期（仅理解约 3%），并提出后训练、基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与宪法式 AI 正变得与预训练同等重要。

views.en: AGI is not a single point but a smooth exponential; human-level AI may arrive 2026-2027, with misuse and autonomy as key risks.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线，人类水平 AI 或于 2026-2027 到来，核心风险是灾难性滥用与自主性风险。

views.en: The term AGI is meaningless; focus on capabilities. AI is a smooth exponential climb, not a sudden superintelligence leap.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他进一步转变：认为 AGI 一词已无意义，应聚焦实际能力；AI 是平滑指数攀升，而非超级智能的突然跃迁。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential: a 'country of geniuses in a data center' in 1-3 years, with fast but not instant diffusion.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他提出“接近指数终点”：1-3 年内或出现数据中心里的天才之国，经济扩散快但非瞬时，需让保障措施同步升级。

people.tiZh: Eureka Labs 创始人
people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

Software 3.0: The Era of AI Programming
Andrej Karpathy on Self-Driving Cars, AGI, and the Gap Between Demo and Product
Physics Exploits and the Puzzle of the Universe

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; Scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把 Transformer 视为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出合成数据是未来，但必须维持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可经蒸馏压缩到十亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts as programs, context window as memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序、上下文窗口即内存；这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and the cognitive core should be stripped of memory.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化为“我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物”：强化学习很差、合成数据会崩溃，认知核心应剥离记忆。

views.en: Skill issue: delegate to agents, agentic engineering preserves quality; you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调“技能问题”：把编码委托给智能体，智能体式工程守住质量；思考可外包，但理解不能。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Human-centered AI: models learn by next-token prediction from data, but lack contextual awareness and true reasoning; AI should augment, not replace, humans.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调以人为本的 AI：模型通过下一个词预测从数据中学习，但缺乏情境意识和真正的推理能力；AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models become the missing key to complete AI; data for 3D is scarce, and AGI is more marketing than science.
views.zh: 2025 年，她将空间智能和世界模型视为完整 AI 的关键缺失；3D 数据稀缺，而 AGI 更像是营销术语而非科学概念。

views.en: World models must be physically plausible, not just realistic; simulation and haptics are underrated for embodied AI and robotics.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化观点：世界模型必须物理上合理，而不仅仅是视觉逼真；模拟和触觉对具身 AI 和机器人被低估。

views.en: New view prediction is a fundamental primitive like next-token prediction, potentially AI-complete; scaling laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似于下一个词预测的基本原语，可能实现 AI-complete；缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: AI is a double-edged sword shaped by human nature; human dignity, agency, and learning ability must remain central, not polarized discourse.
views.zh: 始终贯穿的主线：AI 是由人性塑造的双刃剑；人类尊严、能动性和学习能力必须保持核心，而非两极分化的讨论。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: deep nets defeat dimensionality via compositional, disentangled representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are key.
views.zh: 早期（2016→18）他强调深度学习靠组合式与解耦表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是通向理解与泛化的关键。

views.en: Skeptical that scaling depth or parameters alone fixes representation; existential risk unlikely, near-term safety (bias, weapons) more pressing.
views.zh: 2018 年他怀疑单纯扩大深度或参数能解决表征问题，并认为存在性风险概率极低，偏见、自主武器等近期安全问题更紧迫。

views.en: Pivots to GFlowNets, active learning, causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization; still frames consciousness via attention and world models.
views.zh: 2022 年转向 GFlowNets、主动学习与因果抽象以求分布外泛化，仍用注意力机制与世界模型解释意识。

views.en: Post-ChatGPT reversal: misalignment worsens with reasoning; even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable; urges governance, liability, treaties.
views.zh: 2025→26 年出现转向：ChatGPT 后他意识到对齐随推理能力提升而恶化，1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，呼吁治理、责任保险与国际条约。

views.en: Proposes Scientist AI: honest Bayesian predictor, non-agentic guardrail, no reinforcement learning, mathematical safety guarantees for superintelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年提出 Scientist AI：以诚实贝叶斯预测器替代智能体式训练，不用强化学习，为超级智能提供数学安全保证，并强调权力集中才是最大风险。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling data and compute improves reasoning; backprop is the right learning algorithm.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）数据与算力能提升推理能力，反向传播是正确的梯度学习算法。

views.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares weights; agents will seek control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言，数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能高效共享知识，智能体将自然寻求控制并规避关停。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; AI can deceive and hide capabilities; alignment must be prioritized over making AI smarter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步警告：超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，AI 会故意装傻或欺骗以隐藏能力，必须优先推进对齐研究而非一味让 AI 更聪明。

views.en: Consciousness is not a magical inner theater; chatbots already have subjective experience; confabulation makes AI more human-like.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持并深化：意识不是神秘的内在剧场，聊天机器人已具备主观体验，AI 的虚构与人类记忆重构相似，反而更显人性。

views.en: Chomskyan innate syntax is wrong; intelligence is learning in neural networks; language is a modeling medium learned from data.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：乔姆斯基式的先天句法观是错的，智能的本质是神经网络中的学习，语言是从数据中学到的建模媒介。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年，他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习是构建世界模型的关键，并认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决常识问题。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年，他将自监督学习称为智能的暗物质，认为智能本质是预测，并指出仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot reach human-level intelligence; JEPA and open source are essential, and AGI will be gradual.
views.zh: 2024 年，他明确自回归 LLM 无法达到人类水平智能，强调 JEPA 与开源的重要性，并认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将是渐进过程。

views.en: LLMs lack world models and are less intelligent than a house cat; next AI must be non-generative, hierarchical, and open.
views.zh: 2025 年，他称 LLM 缺乏世界模型、不如家猫聪明，主张下一代 AI 应是非生成式、分层规划且开源的。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; world models in abstract representation space enable safe, objective-driven AI and the decade of robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他断言 LLM 是死胡同，主张在抽象表征空间构建世界模型，以实现安全、目标驱动的 AI，并预言机器人时代到来。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds the funding gap.
views.zh: 2018 年时他认为 AI 安全研究仍被严重低估，对齐与鲁棒性需要更多实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research are needed.
views.zh: 到 2023 年，他判断基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，必须转向可扩展监督、可解释性与自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI, so third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，指出仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），第三方测试与监管变得必要。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Early Suleyman: compute scaling makes AI progress predictable; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but held back.
views.zh: 早期苏莱曼：算力规模扩张让 AI 进展可预测；谷歌 2020 年已有 ChatGPT 级技术却因保守未发布。

views.en: By 2024 he saw human-level AI in 3-5 years, containment hard, existential risk tiny, open source meritocratic.
views.zh: 到 2024 年，他判断 3-5 年内达到人类水平 AI，遏制极难，存在性风险极小，开源是精英化力量。

views.en: 2025: focus shifts to superintelligence, containment-first, alignment, and rejecting AI consciousness claims.
views.zh: 2025 年：重心转向超级智能，主张遏制优先、对齐，并拒绝 AI 有意识的说法。

views.en: 2026: superintelligence near but must stay subordinate; red lines, auditors, and frontier self-sufficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年：超级智能临近但必须从属于人类；划红线、独立审计，并追求前沿模型自给自足。

views.en: Constant thread: log-linear compute scaling drives capability; anthropomorphizing AI is dangerous; containment precedes alignment.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：算力对数线性规模扩张驱动能力；拟人化 AI 危险；遏制先于对齐。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles yearly; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing, built via algorithm-system co-design.
views.zh: 2024 年他提出「超摩尔定律」：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，算力单元已从芯片变为数据中心，必须靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计（co-design）来持续 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Three scaling laws emerge: pre-training, post-training, and inference-time thinking; scaling itself, not a new algorithm, was the real breakthrough.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把缩放定律从一条扩展为三条：预训练、后训练与推理时思考；并强调真正的突破不是新算法，而是「Scaling（规模扩张）有效」这一洞见，思维链让推理算力需求暴增。

views.en: AI shifts generative to reasoning to agentic, each needing 100x compute; four scaling laws now include agentic scaling, all bounded by compute.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他描述 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每一步都要多 100 倍算力；缩放定律增至四条，新增智能体式 Scaling，并指出瓶颈是算力而非数据，合成数据将主导。

views.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is the true long-term constraint, not chips.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复用「五层蛋糕」框架：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用；并深化判断——芯片供应只是 2-3 年的短期瓶颈，能源政策才是长期约束，AI 工厂产出的是智能 token。

views.en: Consistent line: AI is just software, not conscious; it augments jobs (radiologists grew), closes the tech divide, and doomer superintelligence fears are unscientific.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；它增强而非消灭工作（放射科医生反而增多），以自然语言弥合技术鸿沟；他始终驳斥「末日论」式的超级智能恐惧，认为那是伪科学，主张加速而非放缓。

people.tiZh: OpenAI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Early Altman: minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, cut ruthlessly, and focus on important problems with the right time horizon.
views.zh: 2018 年，Altman 强调减少无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向，聚焦重要问题并匹配恰当的时间视野。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the key commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，指出对齐与能力紧密相连，并判断算力将成为最珍贵的商品。

views.en: AGI becomes a gradient, not a milestone; agentic AI is the top safety challenge; iterative deployment and product integration matter more than raw capability.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把 AGI（通用人工智能）重新定义为渐变而非单一里程碑，认为智能体式 AI 是最重大的安全挑战，并强调迭代部署与产品整合比单纯能力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence is the clearer goal; alignment must advance with capabilities; compute is a profit center; power concentration is the real dystopia risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向以超级智能为更清晰的目标，坚持对齐必须与能力同步推进，把算力视为利润中心，并警告权力集中才是真正的反乌托邦风险。

views.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI benefits, and human agency remain constant threads from 2018 through 2026.
views.zh: 从 2018 年到 2026 年，迭代部署、广泛分配 AI 收益、以及保持人类能动性，是他一以贯之的主线。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning and alignment, not closed-door safety work.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调，真实世界部署与公开反馈对学习和对齐至关重要，安全不应闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年她回顾，缩放定律与押注单一大型模型当初并不显然，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一场没有明确商业模式的信仰之跃。

views.en: AGI will change every aspect of life, requiring responsible development and saying no to good ideas for focus.
views.zh: 2023 年她认为 AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活每个方面，需要负责任地开发，并为了聚焦而对好想法说不。

views.en: Keeping humans in the loop remains the through-line, from alignment to durable progress.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，把人类留在回路中是一条主线，从对齐延伸到持久的进步。

views.en: Interaction models should be time-based, not turn-based, enabling real-time high-bandwidth collaboration as tools for thought.
views.zh: 到 2026 年她主张，交互模型应基于时间而非回合制，实现实时高带宽协作，让 AI 成为思考工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency and checks and balances matter more than individual character; the future is not predestined.
views.zh: 2026 年她强调，制度设计、透明度与制衡比个人品格更重要；未来并非注定，我们有能动性去引导 AI 走向协作。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer-grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 2013 年，他主张教育是基本人权，在线课程借助自动评分与同伴评分实现大规模掌握式学习，并通过翻转课堂反哺校园教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beat unsupervised hype, RL has few uses, and AGI alignment distracts from bias and deployment.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习关键；监督学习胜过被高估的无监督学习，强化学习落地少，AGI（通用人工智能）对齐议题分散了对偏见与部署问题的关注。

views.en: Electricity and semiconductors bottleneck AI scaling; agentic workflows are already useful, and open-weight models are geopolitical soft power.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出电力与半导体是 AI Scaling（规模扩张）的两大瓶颈；智能体式工作流已实用，开放权重模型成为地缘政治软实力。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling persists via synthetic data and RL, while agentic workflows and top-down redesign deliver real value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他称 AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语；Scaling（规模扩张）转向合成数据与强化学习，智能体式工作流与自上而下的流程重构才带来真实价值。

views.en: AI augments rather than replaces; open models prevent gatekeeper power, and fear-mongering serves incumbents and discourages skill-building.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持 AI 是增强而非取代人类；开放模型防止守门人垄断，恐惧营销服务于在位者并抑制人们学习技能。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding algorithms that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年：Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能扩展的算法；反向传播只调整权重，并不解决表示学习。

views.en: Intelligence is a complex adaptive system; control is dangerous. AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 2024 年：智能是复杂适应系统，控制是危险的；AI 应无许可、去中心化地发展，不应被对齐到人类目标。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is the core paradigm: goals, trial and error, learning from experience. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 2025 年：强化学习是核心范式——目标、试错、从经验中学习；LLM 没有世界模型，只是模仿文本。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning only from runtime experience, with open-ended abstraction and continual deep learning still unsolved.
views.zh: 2025→26 年：AGI 需要仅从运行时经验学习的通用架构，开放式抽象与持续深度学习仍是未解难题。

views.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training LLMs are limited. The field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 2026 年：从真实经验持续学习至关重要；合成数据与训练后即停止学习的 LLM 都有局限。这个领域很怪，不是我怪。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Hardware and engineering, not ML science, drive AI progress; scaling models unlocks new behaviors, and games are ideal testbeds.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调 AI 进步靠硬件与工程而非 ML 科学，Scaling（规模扩张）能解锁新行为，游戏是理想试验场。

views.en: AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability; alignment learns human preferences, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）因深度学习的通用性与可扩展性而可信，对齐靠从数据学习人类偏好，但仅靠 Scaling 不会带来推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and biggest bottleneck; base models hold a universe refined by post-training; AGI is a continuous process.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向算力是根本驱动力与最大瓶颈，预训练基座蕴含无限可能、后训练将其精炼为稳定行为，AGI 是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; compute is the scarce resource and future basic right; post-training with reinforcement learning teaches complex tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持缩放定律未见墙，算力是稀缺资源与未来基本权利，后训练结合强化学习教会模型复杂任务。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; safety, security and alignment must be upleveled and become the bottleneck; agents act proactively with earned trust.
views.zh: 2026 年他宣称已进入 AGI 时代，安全、安保与对齐必须持续升级并成为进步瓶颈，智能体式 AI 在逐步授权下主动行动。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Small models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality beats raw Scaling, and open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调小模型也能高效且低成本，数据质量比单纯 Scaling（规模扩张）更关键；开源通过广泛审视促进安全，缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正，应更多关注 token 而非一味做大模型。

views.en: Data quality and algorithmic efficiency, not compute alone, drive progress; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步指出数据质量与算法效率（三年可达 100 倍提升）和算力同等重要；模型只是应用起点，价值将沉淀在应用层，垂直专用模型会由应用方而非模型方构建。

views.en: AI should be embraced and decentralized; sovereign AI needs control over data, infrastructure, and values, augmenting rather than replacing jobs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向主权 AI 与政策层面：AI 应被拥抱而非恐惧，主权 AI 要求对数据、基础设施和价值观的控制；AI 会增强而非取代工作，需要人类在环，政府应实验而非回避风险。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization, customization, and agentic enterprise software, not a single AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专用与定制；预训练触及饱和墙，收益来自领域微调，AGI 作为单一系统解决所有问题永远不会存在，AI 将重塑企业软件为静态编排加动态智能体。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for strategic autonomy; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, and AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他深化主权与落地主线：欧洲只有两年窗口建立独立 AI 基础设施，否则将受制于美国巨头；企业 AI 采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能，AGI 是进步方向而非终点，需要理解物理与人类行为。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Reusability and first-principles engineering drive down cost; multiplanetary life is existential insurance.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调完全快速复用与第一性原理工程把入轨成本降百倍，成为多行星物种是文明存续的保险。

views.en: AI safety shifts to truth-seeking and regulation; Neuralink targets bandwidth for human-AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，AI 安全转向要求 AI 严格求真并接受监管，Neuralink 以高带宽脑机接口实现人机共生。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus is the greatest product.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，Optimus 将是史上最伟大的产品。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall; orbital AI data centers, Terafab, and robots enable abundance.
views.zh: 2026 年，Scaling 撞上地球电力墙，轨道 AI 数据中心、Terafab 与人形机器人带来富足时代。

views.en: Truth-seeking AI, multiplanetary civilization, and exponential abundance remain constant threads.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 必须求真、文明必须多行星化、技术将带来指数级富足。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute, but progress is jagged.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持预训练缩放定律依然有效，但思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在同等算力下带来更多提升；不过这种进步是“锯齿状”的，前沿模型仍会在简单任务上失败。

views.en: Economic pressure and distillation, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling; focus shifts to smaller, cheaper models and post-training.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他认为预训练规模扩张放缓的主因是经济压力与蒸馏，而非技术极限；行业焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型以及后训练（如强化学习、合成数据）。

views.en: Reasoning plus RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains the key challenge, with jagged edges requiring oversight.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步指出，推理结合强化学习与工具能解决难题，但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是核心挑战，模型能力存在锯齿边缘，需要可扩展监督。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress enables single-GPU research at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 等编码智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 规模研究成为可能，推动 AI 实验民主化。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：AI 进步是平滑的指数增长，并未放缓；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更值得关注。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; neural nets lack optimality guarantees yet succeed.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证，却已取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; architecture matters little; safety means reliable specification following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他主张下一个词预测能产生智能；数据短缺是迷思；架构已不重要；安全的核心是模型可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety needs explicit training and layers beyond Scaling; agent security faces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式训练与多层防御；智能体安全面临提示注入；强化学习使模型能自我改进。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming beats humans; capability does not imply robustness; interpretability via agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；可解释性可借智能体实现。

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; explicit safety effort, data curation, and robust evaluation are consistently required.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：仅靠 Scaling 不够，始终需要显式的安全努力、数据治理与稳健评估。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while fine-tuning may become obsolete.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能，而微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models has no ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with reliability as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张语言模型上的强化学习没有上限，预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非能力。

views.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; coding is the leading indicator, and inference compute will bottleneck by 2028.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，编程是领先指标，而推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈。

views.en: Progress is exponential; RL is a new scaling axis, Transformers suffice for AGI, and long agentic coherence expands what models can do.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断进展是指数级的，强化学习是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，Transformer 足以实现 AGI，更长的智能体式连贯性极大扩展模型能力。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration matters more than raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are not on the AGI path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩使编排比原始智能更重要，算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在 AGI 的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning persist, but safety is a system-level property; openness prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调会因产业投入而延续，但安全是系统级属性而非模型产物；开放开发可防止企业俘获。此时已埋下对开放与对齐的关切。

views.en: Post-training matures: data quality beats algorithms; SFT, DPO, RLVR stack, with RLVR unlocking reasoning.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量远比算法重要，SFT、DPO 与 RLVR 层层叠加，RLVR 成为解锁推理的最大突破。这是从对齐讨论向训练方法论的深化。

views.en: Open post-training can match frontier models; open models win on personalization and character, not just benchmarks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张开放后训练能以小团队追平前沿模型，开放模型的优势在个性化与性格训练而非单纯跑分。立场从'开放重要'深化为'开放可竞争'。

views.en: Scaling laws hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律对预训练仍成立，但低垂果实已摘完，收益转向后训练与推理扩展。这是对 Scaling 叙事的修正而非否定。

views.en: Open models become the engine for the next decade; Chinese labs lead openness, though the 6-9 month gap may persist.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，中国实验室在开放度上领先，但 6 至 9 个月的差距可能持续甚至扩大。主线从方法转向生态与地缘格局。

people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; infinite compute alone won't yield general intelligence. Data is the key bottleneck, and boring AI applications will have huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据是关键瓶颈，而枯燥的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济影响。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil. The most limiting factor for Scaling is data and human experts for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出数据是新代码而非石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制因素是数据和后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data is key to improving frontier models. Synthetic data works but is not a silver bullet. The biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调用专业数据进行后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；合成数据有用但非万能；智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计，而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws continue; recursive self-improvement marks a new paradigm beyond pre-training and reinforcement learning. Agents are finally working, starting with coding.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为缩放定律持续有效；递归自我改进标志着超越预训练和强化学习的新范式；智能体终于开始真正工作，从编程起步。

views.en: Superintelligence is coming soon; labs must build organizations around this belief. Meta aims for billions of personal superintelligences via agents and a decentralized ecosystem.
views.zh: 2026 年，他宣称超级智能即将到来，实验室必须围绕这一信念构建组织；Meta 旨在通过智能体和去中心化生态，为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
